_comment: Maps NVIDIA 10-K raw label text to standard canonical keys. Labels verified against actual PDF extraction output.

_notes.operating_income: NVIDIA calls this 'Income from operations', not 'Operating income'.
_notes.total_assets: NVIDIA does not have a standalone 'Total assets' row. We use 'Total liabilities and shareholders equity' which equals total assets by accounting identity (Assets = Liabilities + Equity).
_notes.total_revenue: NVIDIA reports a single 'Revenue' line — verified from extraction CSV.
